articles.title: Convicted sex offender set to be released, Durham police issue community safety alert
articles.summary: Police in Durham Regional are warning the public about a high-risk offender who is set to be released on Sunday. In a community safety alert issued on Saturday, authorities said 48-year-old Keith Theodore Constantin has a long history of serious criminal convictions, including sexual assault with a weapon, robbery and posession of explosives. articles.title: Stelco says Hamilton layoffs still happening despite Ottawa's threats of legal action
articles.summary: Hamilton-based steelmaker Stelco says it will proceed with hundreds of layoffs, despite threats of legal action from the federal government.

articles.title: Truck driver dies at Vaughan warehouse, Ontario Labour Ministry investigating
articles.summary: The Ontario Ministry of Labour is investigating an industrial accident after a truck driver died in Vaughan on Friday.

articles.summary: Ontario’s Ministry of Labour is investigating after a truck driver was killed during what officials describe as a “workplace incident” in Vaughan. articles.title: Anthropic’s Claude AI submits a false tip on a Philadelphia unsolved homicide case
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false tip to a Philadelphia police website about an unsolved homicide case, authorities and Anthropic said.

articles.title: Police release video of vehicles in area before fatal hit and run in Vaughan
articles.summary: Police have released new video of three vehicles in the area where a woman was fatally struck in a Vaughan hit and run on the weekend, saying they're hoping to speak to the drivers.

articles.title: Oshawa mayoral candidates focus on homelessness, downtown concerns at debate
articles.summary: Candidates shared plans to tackle homelessness and revitalize downtown Oshawa during Thursday's debate, hosted by the Greater Oshawa Chamber of Commerce at the Bond St. Event Centre.

articles.title: Ontario will officially begin removing Toronto bike lanes on Tuesday
articles.summary: Ontario will begin removing bike lanes from a stretch on Bloor Street W. in Etobicoke on Tuesday, the Ministry of Transportation says.
